name: Anatomy Learning Labs: Complete Set
summary:
Step into the Complete Set of the Anatomy Learning Labs series, where science meets wonder inside the human body in stunning 3D. Featuring anatomically accurate models developed by medical professionals and learning activities designed by professors, the Complete Set brings together the skeletal, muscular, cardiovascular, respiratory, digestive, neural and sensory labs into one package to show how these systems work together to support human life.
